title: Evaluating Harmful Memorization in LLM Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2503.02296v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Assessing memorization in LLM code generation is challenging because code reuse is not inherently harmful. Correct programs often share APIs, templates, and algorithmic idioms, so code similarity alone may reflect benign reuse rather than problematic memorization. We focus on the harmful case: a model fails to adapt when task semantics change and instead produces code that remains highly similar to the original solution. We propose \emph{code rewriting}, an automated semantic perturbation pipeline that constructs superficially similar but semantically different variants of existing coding tasks by modifying a core logic element of the reference solution and regenerating the corresponding prompt. To summarize this behavior, we introduce the \emph{Harmful Memorization Index} (HMI), an operational diagnostic that combines similarity to the original solution with performance degradation on rewritten tasks. translated_title: 评估大语言模型代码生成中的有害记忆现象
translated_abstract: 评估大语言模型代码生成中的记忆现象具有挑战性，因为代码复用本身并非有害。正确的程序往往共享API、模板和算法惯用法，因此仅凭代码相似性可能反映的是良性复用而非有问题的记忆。我们关注有害的情形：当任务语义发生变化时，模型未能做出相应调整，而是生成与原始解法高度相似的代码。我们提出“代码重写”，这是一种自动化语义扰动流水线，通过修改参考解法的核心逻辑元素并重新生成相应的提示，来构建表面相似但语义不同的编程任务变体。为刻画这种行为，我们引入“有害记忆指数”，这是一个操作性诊断指标，结合了生成代码与原始解法的相似度以及在重写任务上的性能下降。我们将有害记忆作为评估大语言模型代码生成能力的关键维度。
tldr: 提出代码重写流水线和有害记忆指数（HMI），通过检测模型在任务语义改变后仍生成与原解法高度相似代码并伴随性能下降的现象，来有效评估大语言模型代码生成中的有害记忆。
en_tdlr: Proposes a code rewriting pipeline and the Harmful Memorization Index (HMI) to evaluate harmful memorization in LLM code generation by detecting cases where models fail to adapt to semantic task changes and instead produce code highly similar to original solutions with degraded performance.
